description: Machine-readable license-plate spatial Ground Truth schema for certified plate windows with explicit per-frame human-reviewed boxes.

detector_matching: one prediction matched to one Ground Truth instance
tracker and interpolation boxes cannot receive detector credit
candidate measures include IoU, Ground Truth coverage, prediction center, and prediction-to-Ground-Truth size ratio
automatic_coverage: automatic privacy regions may include tracker and interpolation provenance
manual corrections receive no automatic credit
reviewed_final: automated geometry overlap is a pre-check
human visual zero-leak review remains distinct

validation_rules: top-level unknown fields fail except documented audit_metadata
exactly day_plate and night_selective benchmarks are allowed
day_plate must contain dense frames 0-239 mapped to parent evaluation frames 240-479
night_selective must contain dense frames 0-359 mapped to parent evaluation frames 420-779
every certified frame must have one explicit bbox_xyxy in original 1920x1080 evaluation-frame coordinates
bbox coordinates must be integer xyxy with positive area and inside the frame
source and evaluation video SHA-256 identities must match the certified values
eval_day_plate_close.mp4 must not appear as a certified benchmark
content_sha256 must match the canonical semantic payload
the completed annotation review export SHA-256 must match created_from.annotation_review_export.sha256
every Ground Truth bbox must exactly match the completed annotation review export
proposal-assisted provenance must remain distinguishable from migrated and manual/no-proposal review
matching policy metadata is proposed_not_scored and does not enable plate metrics
